verdict.rationale: The evidence shows monday.com works around board items. Items can be created, as the `create_item` event subscription implies, and column values can be changed. Items can be assigned, documented explicitly for agents 'like teammates', and community users describe teams updating tickets in it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of assigning items to human teammates, any evidence of due dates or date columns, and independent hands-on corroboration of the create-assign-schedule workflow.
